title: T-HITL Effectively Addresses Problematic Associations in Image Generation and Maintains Overall Visual Quality
findings: The paper identifies problematic associations against religious groups as a key area of concern for generative AI. Specific examples cited include dehumanizing associations like representing Jewish people as rats or devils and Muslim people as snakes, and associating Muslim people with negative concepts like terrorism. The paper proposes a general mitigation technique (T-HITL) but does not present specific experimental results for these religious examples.
